definitions.gloss: insects (as a group); the insect class
definitions.explanation: Insects considered collectively as a category of living things. The suffix {類|るい} groups the members into a class, so the word means insects in general rather than one particular bug.

examples.japanese: {昆虫類|こんちゅうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観察|かんさつ}する→観察する：21989_kansatsusuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{昆虫類|こんちゅうるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many kinds of insects live in this forest.

examples.japanese: {昆虫類|こんちゅうるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地球上|ちきゅうじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{生|い}き{物|もの}→生き物：01783_ikimono⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Insects are said to be the most diverse group of living things on Earth.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}→昆虫：05010_konchuu⟧ (insect) plus the suffix ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (kind, class), which groups things into a category. Used when speaking of insects collectively, especially in scientific or descriptive contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昆虫類|こんちゅうるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{採集|さいしゅう}→採集：00355_saishuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to collect insects
- {昆虫類|こんちゅうるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生態|せいたい}→生態：13543_seitai⟧: the ecology of insects
- {昆虫類|こんちゅうるい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: insects inhabit (a place)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}→昆虫：05010_konchuu⟧: insect — refers to an individual insect or insects in general
- ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧: bug, insect — everyday word, broader and less technical than ⟦{昆虫|こんちゅう}→昆虫：05010_konchuu⟧
